quark_recommendation.name: Supabase (Current Primary)
pros: Free tier sufficient for current needs
cons: May need paid tier as project grows
quark_recommendation.recommendation: RECOMMENDED: Already in use, free tier sufficient, best ROI

phase1.name: Immediate Implementation
steps: Use existing Supabase setup (no new infrastructure)
Leverage current n8n → Supabase DDD flow
Implement StateSyncManager with Supabase backend
Create vector storage schema in existing Supabase instance

phase2.name: RBAC & Tier Routing
steps: Add RBAC tables to Supabase (free tier)
Implement tier detection in Next.js routing
Add permission checks in API routes
Test three-tier access control

phase3.name: Optimization & Monitoring
steps: Monitor Supabase usage (stay within free tier)
Optimize sync frequency to reduce API calls
Implement caching strategies
Set up usage alerts

future.name: Scale Planning (If Needed)
steps: Monitor Supabase usage metrics
If approaching free tier limits, evaluate paid tier ($25/month)
Consider AWS S3 for large file storage if needed
Keep AWS credentials in ~/.zshrc for future use

rationale: Already integrated and working (zero setup cost)
Free tier sufficient for current mission requirements
